title: Online Salon Booking System
summary: Appointment scheduling platform allowing clients to book salon services and manage staff timetables.
problem: Phone-based salon appointments lead to booking overlaps, missed appointments, and double-scheduled stylists.
solution: Engineered an online booking engine with real-time time-slot availability and automated confirmation.
features: Real-time appointment slot selection and stylist allocation
Client booking management and service catalog pricing
Admin dashboard for managing daily salon schedules
